AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Manages the user's personal todo list with the same capabilities as the app: reading todos, adding them, editing them (text, pin to top, reminder, repeat rule, checklist, tags), marking them done or reopening them, and deleting them. Operational patterns: - Call 'getTodoList' first to resolve a todo the user mentions by text to its ID before calling 'editTodo', 'changeTodoDoneStatus' or 'deleteTodo'. - 'editTodo' only changes the parameters that are passed; use 'clearReminder' / 'clearRecurrence' to remove those. Checklist and tags are replaced as a whole list. - Dates and times are the user's local wall-clock time in ISO-8601 without a zone, e.g. 2026-10-03T09:30. - A repeating todo that is marked done becomes active again on its own when its next occurrence is due. Constraints: - Todo text cannot be empty. - Reminders must be in the future, and only active (not completed) todos can have one. - Deleting can't be undone: always confirm with the user before calling 'deleteTodo'.
